test_to_period_default: test the to_period method converts DataFrame index with default daily frequency to PeriodIndex
test_to_period_freq: test the to_period method with a frequency argument converts the index to the specified period frequency
test_to_period_without_freq: test the to_period method on a DatetimeIndex without an explicit frequency defaults to daily period frequency
test_to_period_columns: test the to_period method with axis=1 converts column DatetimeIndex to PeriodIndex
test_to_period_invalid_axis: test the to_period method raises ValueError when given an invalid axis value
